final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN points END) AS avg_points, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN wins END) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT per_race.raceId, per_race.avg_points, per_race.avg_wins, per_race.avg_wins - overall.overall_avg_wins AS win_difference FROM per_race CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY win_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
